basic_info.description: Affordable hidden gem nestled in the desirable Excelsior neighborhood. Walking distance to Asian grocery stores, restaurants, public transportation along the vibrant Mission St. This bright and airy 2 bedroom 1 bath home features brand new interior and exterior front painting, two year new roof, new water proof vinyl floor and new toilet, new vanity cabinet in the bathroom. Oversized living room with bay windows full of natural light. Hardwood floor throughout the living room and two spacious bedrooms. A lovely sunroom by the kitchen opens to the lush back yard where you will see concrete paved area perfect for BBQ and outdoor furniture, surrounded by cherry tree, plum tree, lemon tree,  Camellia, bamboo and flowers. The 1300 Sq Ft. per tax record additionally boasts unwarranted kitchenette, a full bathroom and two bonus rooms on the garage level that can be used as storage, guest suite or multi-generation living. Located in a desirable SF Excelsior area, this home enjoys proximity to Asian supermarkets, farmers market, Glen Park BART, while offering a quiet residential feel. You'll love the easy access to public transpiration as well as the vibrant culture and local attractions that make San Francisco living so sought after. Great value, don't miss this move-in ready home!
